Ruijie RG-EW1300G AC1300 Mbps Gigabit Dual-Band Mesh Wi-Fi 5 Router

The Ruijie RG-EW1300G is a high-performance dual-band WiFi 5 (802.11ac Wave 2) router designed for home and small office environments. It delivers combined wireless speeds of up to 1300 Mbps — 450 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band and 867 Mbps on the 5 GHz band — ensuring smooth streaming, online gaming, and fast internet browsing.


Key Features:


  • Dual-Band WiFi: Simultaneous 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands for better performance and reduced interference.
  • Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Includes 1 WAN and 4 LAN gigabit ports for high-speed wired connections.
  • MU-MIMO Technology: Supports multiple devices with simultaneous data transmission, improving network efficiency.
  • Wide Coverage: Covers up to 2500 square feet, suitable for medium to large homes and small offices.
  • Easy Setup and Management: Quick setup with mobile-friendly configuration via the Reyee Router App.
  • Advanced Security: Includes WPA-PSK/WPA2-PSK encryption, firewall, and VPN pass-through.
  • Multi-Mode Support: Can operate as a router, access point, repeater, or WISP for flexible deployment.

Specifications:


Wireless Standards: IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac

Max Speed: Up to 1300 Mbps (450 Mbps @ 2.4 GHz + 867 Mbps @ 5 GHz)

Processor: Dual-core CPU with hyper-threading

Memory: 128MB RAM / 16MB Flash

Ports: 1 x Gigabit WAN, 4 x Gigabit LAN

Power Supply: DC 12V/1.0A, <12W

Dimensions: 230 x 130 x 30 mm

Weight: 0.29 kg
